Absolute Value of Romance

로맨스의 절대값

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2026

⭐☆☆☆☆1B/10

Overview

Absolute Value of Romance follows Yeo Eui-ju, an ordinary high school sophomore who secretly writes Boys' Love (BL) web novels under the pen name Imuk. Despite writing over a hundred episodes, her novels receive almost no attention. Everything changes when four incredibly handsome teachers arrive at her school and become the inspiration for her new story. The four teachers are Ga U-su, a brilliant mathematics teacher with a painful past; Noh Da-ju, a playful Japanese teacher and U-su's lifelong friend; Jung Gi-jeon, a former Olympic athlete turned PE teacher; and Yoon Dong-ju, a calm and respectful Korean literature teacher. After using them as the main characters in her newest BL novel, Eui-ju unexpectedly becomes a successful writer. However, her secret is discovered by her strict math teacher, Ga U-su. Instead of exposing her, he proposes a deal that forces Eui-ju to balance school life, writing novels, mathematics, friendships, and the confusing feelings developing between fantasy and reality.

My Review

I really enjoyed this series. I laughed so much while watching it. As someone who romanticizes BL stories, I could honestly relate to Eui-ju. Watching her secretly write BL novels, imagine different scenarios, and become completely invested in her stories reminded me of myself sometimes. The comedy was one of the strongest parts of the series. Almost every episode had scenes that made me laugh, especially whenever Eui-ju got caught in awkward situations because of her imagination. Although there were moments where I got irritated with Eui-ju, especially whenever she became jealous despite having no right to be, I still loved her character. She felt very realistic and relatable. The four teachers all had different charms, making it easy to understand why Eui-ju used them as inspiration for her stories. Their personalities balanced each other well, making the interactions fun to watch. Overall, this series was lighthearted, funny, and perfect for anyone who enjoys romantic comedies mixed with school life and a little bit of BL humor.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Every scene where Eui-ju imagines BL scenarios involving the four teachers. • The hilarious moments whenever Ga U-su catches Eui-ju doing something embarrassing. • The comedy scenes between the teachers that made almost every episode enjoyable.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"I'm going to try to understand irrational numbers."
